claim_notes.automatic_convention_inference_for_any_d: Candidate inference recognises a data layer only when its import specifier contains prisma, database, db, or data-access (is_data_access_source in crates/drift-engine/src/candidate_command.rs). Repos naming theirs store/supabase/repository/models yield zero inferred candidates. Drift reports this explicitly and suggests the module found by tracing package.json dependencies through repo imports; the human declares it with --data-modules. Claimable capability is therefore 'bootstraps and enforces a declared layering contract with per-line evidence', not 'learns your conventions'. Lift when structural construction-site detection lands.
